side_rule: LB ROLE CONVENTION (t46u): every off-ball linebacker is assigned to exactly one of MIKE/WILL/SAM by his primary 2025-26 role = snap-weighted share of nflverse depth-chart snapshots: Base 4-3 MLB -> MIKE, WLB -> WILL, SLB -> SAM; Base 3-4 RILB (strong-side inside LB) -> MIKE, LILB (weak-side inside LB) -> WILL; 3-4 WLB/SLB are edge rushers (LEDGE/REDGE lists). Each season's slot shares are weighted by that season's nflverse defensive snaps; largest share wins (tie -> MIKE, then WILL). Players are matched by gsis/PFR id, not name. Each player appears in one list only.
coverage_check: League-wide screen of every off-ball linebacker: all PFF LB grades 2025 (187) and 2026 (149) (pff.com/grades/nfl/lb), PFR coverage/tackling/pressure lines (2025 season, 2026 weekly), nflverse depth charts 2025/2026 for MIKE/WILL/SAM role, snaps, stats, penalties, injuries; reserve/IR (Cooper, Chenal, Speed, White, Franklin), inactive (Deablo, J. Campbell), free agents (Wagner, L. David, L. Wilson) and rookies included. PAYWALLED GAPS: PFF run-defense/coverage/tackling sub-grades and alignment splits; substitutes: PFF LB overall + run/coverage/pass-rush snap counts, PFR coverage targets/yards/passer rating allowed, tackles/missed tackles, pressures/blitzes, TFL/INT/PD
contention_basis: Judgment, not formula: 10 proposed top-10 WILLs plus three first-outs. Evidence: PFF LB overall (sub-grades paywalled), PFR coverage allowed, tackles vs missed tackles, blitz pressures, TFL/INT/PD, penalties, availability, primary role share.
